interfaces.name: Customer & Account Sync
interfaces.description: New and updated customer and account records are pushed from CRM to the Customer Information System to keep billing accounts in sync with sales and service records.

interfaces.name: Self-Service Account & Billing Data
interfaces.description: The customer self-service portal reads account and billing data from the Customer Information System, and writes back customer-submitted contact and preference updates.

interfaces.name: Validated Consumption Feed
interfaces.description: Validated and estimated consumption data is sent from Meter Data Management to the Customer Information System for bill generation.

interfaces.name: Raw Meter Read Collection
interfaces.description: Raw interval reads are collected from the Head-End System and passed to Meter Data Management for validation and estimation.

interfaces.name: Tariff Rating Exchange
interfaces.description: The Customer Information System sends consumption and account context to the Tariff & Pricing Engine for rating, and receives calculated charges back.

interfaces.name: Revenue Postings to GL
interfaces.description: Billed revenue and associated cost-centre allocations are posted from the Customer Information System to the ERP general ledger.

interfaces.name: Work Order Dispatch & Completion
interfaces.description: Maintenance work orders raised in the asset register are dispatched to Field Service Management for scheduling, and completion status is returned.

interfaces.name: Asset Location Reference Feed
interfaces.description: Asset location and network-topology reference data is supplied from the GIS to the asset register to keep asset records spatially located.

interfaces.name: Network Model Synchronisation
interfaces.description: The distribution network model is built from GIS connectivity data, with as-built changes from network operations synchronised back to the GIS.

interfaces.name: Outage Detection & Switching Coordination
interfaces.description: The ADMS detects network outages and notifies the OMS, which returns switching and restoration orders for execution.

interfaces.name: Outage Status Notifications
interfaces.description: Outage status and estimated restoration times are pushed from the OMS to the Contact Centre Platform for customer communications.

interfaces.name: Restoration Crew Dispatch
interfaces.description: Outage restoration jobs are dispatched from the OMS to Field Service Management for crew assignment.

interfaces.name: Grid Constraint Feed for Trading
interfaces.description: Real-time grid state and constraint information from the EMS feeds the Market Data Platform to inform trading decisions.

interfaces.name: Market Price & Curve Feed
interfaces.description: Wholesale market prices and forward curves are fed from the Market Data Platform into the ETRM for trade valuation.

interfaces.name: Position & Risk Exchange
interfaces.description: Trade and position data is sent from the ETRM to Trading Risk Analytics, which returns risk metrics and limit utilisation.

interfaces.name: Trade Settlement Postings
interfaces.description: Settled trade financials are posted from the ETRM to the ERP general ledger.

interfaces.name: Customer & Billing Data Ingestion
interfaces.description: Customer, account, and billing data is replicated from the Customer Information System into the Data Lakehouse for analytics.

interfaces.name: Consumption Data Ingestion
interfaces.description: Validated consumption data is replicated from Meter Data Management into the Data Lakehouse for analytics and modelling.

interfaces.name: Curated Data for Reporting
interfaces.description: Curated datasets are made available from the Data Lakehouse to BI & Analytics for dashboards and reporting.

interfaces.name: Feature Data for Model Training
interfaces.description: Feature data is made available from the Data Lakehouse to the ML / AI Platform for model training.

interfaces.name: Customer Master Data Sync
interfaces.description: Golden customer and account records are distributed from Master Data Management to the Customer Information System, with local updates fed back for matching and survivorship.

interfaces.name: Customer Master Distribution to CRM
interfaces.description: Golden customer records are distributed from Master Data Management to the CRM.

interfaces.name: Emissions Data for ESG Disclosure
interfaces.description: Calculated emissions data is fed from the Emissions Tracking Platform into the ESG Reporting Platform for disclosure aggregation.

interfaces.name: ESG Metrics for Regulatory Filings
interfaces.description: ESG metrics and disclosures are fed from the ESG Reporting Platform into the Regulatory Reporting Platform for statutory filings.
